Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a vote on any local ordinance providing for fluoridation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing for a public vote on the fluoridationof public water supplies; adding a new section to chapter 35.13A RCW;adding a new section to chapter 35.17 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 36.01 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.13A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a water district adopts an ordinance providing for thefluoridation of a public water supply, it shall submit the ordinance toa vote of the people at a general or special election where it must beapproved by a majority of those voting thereon.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a city or town legislative body adopts an ordinance providingfor the fluoridation of a public water supply, it shall submit theordinance to a vote of the people at a general or special electionwhere it must be approved by a majority of those voting thereon.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a county legislative body adopts an ordinance providing for thefluoridation of a public water supply, it shall submit the ordinance toa vote of the people at a general or special election where it must beapproved by a majority of those voting thereon.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
